title: USDe Supply by Chain, Reconciled to Ethereum, Oct 12, 2026
headline: How much USDe was on each chain, and did it add up?
name: USDe supply by chain
description: On October 12, 2026, Ethena's LayerZero adapter on Ethereum held 2.29 billion USDe, and the USDe on 35 other chains came within 95.45 USDe of it.
imageAlt: Horizontal bar chart of USDe on each chain read at about 18:41 UTC on October 12, 2026, in millions, and its share of the USDe locked on Ethereum. Plasma 578.5, 25.2%. Solana 468.5, 20.4%. Base 392.2, 17.1%. Robinhood Chain 372.5, 16.3%. TON 169.1, 7.4%. Monad 114.6, 5.0%. Mantle 82.5, 3.6%. BNB Chain 78.4, 3.4%. Berachain 13.0, 0.6%. Avalanche 10.9, 0.5%. 25 other chains 12.1, 0.5%.
